dct_description_sm: All elicitation materials from session with Nancy Jones on January 21st, 2025. Establishing initial background about Border Lakes Ojibwe (BLO) obviation and voice system. Specifically testing the flexibility of BLO word order in transitive sentences with two 3rd person referents.
